verses.en: The words of Amos, who was among the herdsmen of Tekoa, which he saw concerning Israel in the days of Uzziah king of Judah and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash, king of Israel, two years before the earthquake.
verses.zh: 当犹大王乌西雅，以色列王约阿施的儿子耶罗波安在位的时候，大地震前二年，提哥亚牧人中的阿摩司得默示论以色列。

words.g: in + a spotter , i.e. the owner or tender
from + Tekoa, a place in Palestine
Uzzijah, the name of five Israelites
Jehudah , the name of five Israelites
Jarobam, the name of two Israelite kings
Joash, the name of six Israelites

verses.en: He said: “The LORD will roar from Zion, and utter his voice from Jerusalem; and the pastures of the shepherds will mourn, and the top of Carmel will wither.”
verses.zh: 他说：耶和华必从锡安吼叫，从耶路撒冷发声；牧人的草场要悲哀；迦密的山顶要枯干。

words.g: from + Tsijon , a mountain of Jerusalem
and + from + Jerushalaim or Jerushalem, the capital city of Palestine
the + Karmel, the name of a hill and of a town in Palestine

verses.en: The LORD says: “For three transgressions of Damascus, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment, because they have threshed Gilead with threshing instruments of iron;
verses.zh: 耶和华如此说：大马士革三番四次地犯罪，我必不免去她的刑罚；因为她以打粮食的铁器打过基列。

words.g: the + Gilad, a region East of the Jordan

verses.en: but I will send a fire into the house of Hazael, and it will devour the palaces of Ben Hadad.
verses.zh: 我却要降火在哈薛的家中，烧灭便哈达的宫殿。

words.g: Ben-Hadad, the name of several Syrian kings
Ben-Hadad, the name of several Syrian kings

verses.en: I will break the bar of Damascus, and cut off the inhabitant from the valley of Aven, and him who holds the scepter from the house of Eden; and the people of Syria shall go into captivity to Kir,” says the LORD.
verses.zh: 我必折断大马士革的门闩，剪除亚文平原的居民和伯•伊甸掌权的。亚兰人必被掳到吉珥。这是耶和华说的。

words.g: from + a split, i.e. a wide level valley between mountains
Aven, the contemptuous synonym of three places
Aram or Syria, and its inhabitants

verses.en: The LORD says: “For three transgressions of Gaza, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment, because they carried away captive the whole community, to deliver them up to Edom;
verses.zh: 耶和华如此说：迦萨三番四次地犯罪，我必不免去她的刑罚；因为她掳掠众民交给以东。

words.g: to + Edom, the elder twin-brother of Jacob

verses.en: but I will send a fire on the wall of Gaza, and it will devour its palaces.
verses.zh: 我却要降火在迦萨的城内，烧灭其中的宫殿。

verses.en: I will cut off the inhabitant from Ashdod, and him who holds the scepter from Ashkelon; and I will turn my hand against Ekron; and the remnant of the Philistines will perish,” says the Lord GOD.
verses.zh: 我必剪除亚实突的居民和亚实基伦掌权的，也必反手攻击以革伦。非利士人所余剩的必都灭亡。这是主耶和华说的。

words.g: from + Ashdod, a place in Palestine
from + Ashkelon, a place in Palestine
a Pelishtite or inhabitant of Pelesheth

verses.en: The LORD says: “For three transgressions of Tyre, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment; because they delivered up the whole community to Edom, and didn’t remember the brotherly covenant;
verses.zh: 耶和华如此说：泰尔三番四次地犯罪，我必不免去她的刑罚；因为她将众民交给以东，并不记念弟兄的盟约。

words.g: to + Edom, the elder twin-brother of Jacob

verses.en: but I will send a fire on the wall of Tyre, and it will devour its palaces.”
verses.zh: 我却要降火在泰尔的城内，烧灭其中的宫殿。

verses.en: The LORD says: “For three transgressions of Edom, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment, because he pursued his brother with the sword and cast off all pity, and his anger raged continually, and he kept his wrath forever;
verses.zh: 耶和华如此说：以东三番四次地犯罪，我必不免去她的刑罚；因为她拿刀追赶兄弟，毫无怜悯，发怒撕裂，永怀忿怒。

words.g: Edom, the elder twin-brother of Jacob
a goal, i.e. the bright object at adistance travelled towards

verses.en: but I will send a fire on Teman, and it will devour the palaces of Bozrah.”
verses.zh: 我却要降火在提幔，烧灭波斯拉的宫殿。

words.g: in + Teman, the name of two Edomites

verses.en: The LORD says: “For three transgressions of the children of Ammon, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment, because they have ripped open the pregnant women of Gilead, that they may enlarge their border.
verses.zh: 耶和华如此说：亚扪人三番四次地犯罪，我必不免去他们的刑罚；因为他们剖开基列的孕妇，扩张自己的境界。

words.g: the + Gilad, a region East of the Jordan

verses.en: But I will kindle a fire in the wall of Rabbah, and it will devour its palaces, with shouting in the day of battle, with a storm in the day of the whirlwind;
verses.zh: 我却要在争战呐喊的日子，旋风狂暴的时候，点火在拉巴的城内，烧灭其中的宫殿。

words.g: and + to burn or set on fire
Rabbah, the name of two places in Palestine
in + clamor, i.e. acclamation of joy or a battle-cry

verses.en: and their king will go into captivity, he and his princes together,” says the LORD.
verses.zh: 他们的王和首领必一同被掳去。这是耶和华说的。

verses.en: The LORD says: “For three transgressions of Moab, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment, because he burned the bones of the king of Edom into lime;
verses.zh: 耶和华如此说：摩押三番四次地犯罪，我必不免去她的刑罚；因为她将以东王的骸骨焚烧成灰。

words.g: Moab, an incestuous son of Lot
Edom, the elder twin-brother of Jacob

verses.en: but I will send a fire on Moab, and it will devour the palaces of Kerioth; and Moab will die with tumult, with shouting, and with the sound of the trumpet;
verses.zh: 我却要降火在摩押，烧灭加略的宫殿。摩押必在哄嚷呐喊吹角之中死亡。

words.g: in + Moab, an incestuous son of Lot
the + Kerioth, the name of two places in Palestine
Moab, an incestuous son of Lot
in + clamor, i.e. acclamation of joy or a battle-cry

verses.en: and I will cut off the judge from among them, and will kill all its princes with him,” says the LORD.
verses.zh: 我必剪除摩押中的审判者，将其中的一切首领和他一同杀戮。这是耶和华说的。

words.g: from + the nearest part, i.e. the center + +her/its

verses.en: The LORD says: “For three transgressions of Judah, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment, because they have rejected the LORD’s law, and have not kept his statutes, and their lies have led them astray, after which their fathers walked;
verses.zh: 耶和华如此说：犹大人三番四次地犯罪，我必不免去他们的刑罚；因为他们厌弃耶和华的训诲，不遵守他的律例。他们列祖所随从虚假的偶像使他们走迷了。

words.g: Jehudah , the name of five Israelites
and + to vacillate, i.e. reel or stray + +them/their
father, in a literal and immediate + +them/their

verses.en: but I will send a fire on Judah, and it will devour the palaces of Jerusalem.”
verses.zh: 我却要降火在犹大，烧灭耶路撒冷的宫殿。

words.g: in + Jehudah , the name of five Israelites
Jerushalaim or Jerushalem, the capital city of Palestine

verses.en: The LORD says: “For three transgressions of Israel, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment, because they have sold the righteous for silver, and the needy for a pair of sandals;
verses.zh: 耶和华如此说：以色列人三番四次地犯罪，我必不免去他们的刑罚；因他们为银子卖了义人，为一双鞋卖了穷人。

verses.en: They trample the heads of the poor into the dust of the earth and deny justice to the oppressed. A man and his father use the same maiden, to profane my holy name.
verses.zh: 他们见穷人头上所蒙的灰也都垂涎，阻碍谦卑人的道路。父子同一个女子行淫，亵渎我的圣名。

words.g: and + father, in a literal and immediate + +him/his/it

verses.en: They lay themselves down beside every altar on clothes taken in pledge. In the house of their God they drink the wine of those who have been fined.
verses.zh: 他们在各坛旁铺人所当的衣服，卧在其上，又在他们神的庙中喝受罚之人的酒。

words.g: to wind tightly , i.e. to bind

verses.en: Yet I destroyed the Amorite before them, whose height was like the height of the cedars, and he was strong as the oaks; yet I destroyed his fruit from above, and his roots from beneath.
verses.zh: 我从以色列人面前除灭亚摩利人。他虽高大如香柏树，坚固如橡树，我却上灭他的果子，下绝他的根本。

words.g: the + an Emorite, one of the Canaanitish tribes
like + {an oak or other strong tree}
from + the upper part, used only adverbially with prefix upward

verses.en: Also I brought you up out of the land of Egypt and led you forty years in the wilderness, to possess the land of the Amorite.
verses.zh: 我也将你们从埃及地领上来，在旷野引导你们四十年，使你们得亚摩利人之地为业。

words.g: Mitsrajim, i.e. Upper and Lower Egypt
the + an Emorite, one of the Canaanitish tribes

verses.en: I raised up some of your sons for prophets, and some of your young men for Nazirites. Isn’t this true, you children of Israel?” says the LORD.
verses.zh: 我从你们子弟中兴起先知，又从你们少年人中兴起拿细耳人。以色列人哪，不是这样吗？这是耶和华说的。

words.g: to + a prophet or  inspired man
and + from + selected, i.e. a youth + +you/your

verses.en: “But you gave the Nazirites wine to drink, and commanded the prophets, saying, ‘Don’t prophesy!’
verses.zh: 你们却给拿细耳人酒喝，嘱咐先知说：不要说预言。

words.g: and + to quaff, i.e.  to irrigate or furnish apotion to
the + a prophet or  inspired man
to prophesy, i.e. speak  by inspiration

verses.en: Behold, I will crush you in your place, as a cart crushes that is full of grain.
verses.zh: 看哪，在你们所住之地，我必压你们，如同装满禾捆的车压物一样。

words.g: the + something revolving, i.e. a wheeled vehicle

verses.en: Flight will perish from the swift. The strong won’t strengthen his force. The mighty won’t deliver himself.
verses.zh: 快跑的不能逃脱；有力的不能用力；刚勇的也不能自救。

words.g: to be alert, physically  or mentally
to be smooth, i.e.  to escape

verses.en: He who handles the bow won’t stand. He who is swift of foot won’t escape. He who rides the horse won’t deliver himself.
verses.zh: 拿弓的不能站立；腿快的不能逃脱；骑马的也不能自救。

words.g: the + a bow, forshooting  or the iris
to be smooth, i.e.  to escape
to be smooth, i.e.  to escape

verses.en: He who is courageous among the mighty will flee away naked on that day,” says the LORD.
verses.zh: 到那日，勇士中最有胆量的，必赤身逃跑。这是耶和华说的。

verses.en: Hear this word that the LORD has spoken against you, children of Israel, against the whole family which I brought up out of the land of Egypt, saying:
verses.zh: 以色列人哪，你们全家是我从埃及地领上来的，当听耶和华攻击你们的话：

words.g: the + a family, i.e. circle of relatives
Mitsrajim, i.e. Upper and Lower Egypt

verses.en: “I have chosen only you of all the families of the earth. Therefore I will punish you for all of your sins.”
verses.zh: 在地上万族中，我只认识你们；因此，我必追讨你们的一切罪孽。

words.g: a family, i.e. circle of relatives

verses.en: Do two walk together, unless they have agreed?
verses.zh: 二人若不同心，岂能同行呢？

words.g: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!

verses.en: Will a lion roar in the thicket, when he has no prey? Does a young lion cry out of his den, if he has caught nothing?
verses.zh: 狮子若非抓食，岂能在林中咆哮呢？少壮狮子若无所得，岂能从洞中发声呢？

words.g: and + something torn, i.e. a fragment
used very widely as demonstrative, lo!

verses.en: Can a bird fall in a trap on the earth, where no snare is set for him? Does a snare spring up from the ground, when there is nothing to catch?
verses.zh: 若没有机槛，雀鸟岂能陷在网罗里呢？网罗若无所得，岂能从地上翻起呢？

verses.en: Does the trumpet alarm sound in a city, without the people being afraid? Does evil happen to a city, and the LORD hasn’t done it?
verses.zh: 城中若吹角，百姓岂不惊恐呢？灾祸若临到一城，岂非耶和华所降的吗？

words.g: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!
used very widely as demonstrative, lo!

verses.en: Surely the Lord GOD will do nothing, unless he reveals his secret to his servants the prophets.
verses.zh: 主耶和华若不将奥秘指示他的仆人―众先知，就一无所行。

words.g: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!
the + a prophet or  inspired man

verses.en: The lion has roared. Who will not fear? The Lord GOD has spoken. Who can but prophesy?
verses.zh: 狮子吼叫，谁不惧怕呢？主耶和华发命，谁能不说预言呢？

words.g: to prophesy, i.e. speak  by inspiration

verses.en: Proclaim in the palaces at Ashdod, and in the palaces in the land of Egypt, and say, “Assemble yourselves on the mountains of Samaria, and see what unrest is in her, and what oppression is among them.”
verses.zh: 要在亚实突的宫殿中和埃及地的宫殿里传扬说：你们要聚集在撒马利亚的山上，就看见城中有何等大的扰乱与欺压的事。

words.g: in + Ashdod, a place in Palestine
Mitsrajim, i.e. Upper and Lower Egypt
and + used in plural masculine as abstractly, tyranny
in + the nearest part, i.e. the center + +her/its

verses.en: “Indeed they don’t know to do right,” says the LORD, “Who hoard plunder and loot in their palaces.”
verses.zh: 那些以强暴抢夺财物、积蓄在自己家中的人不知道行正直的事。这是耶和华说的。

verses.en: Therefore the Lord GOD says: “An adversary will overrun the land; and he will pull down your strongholds, and your fortresses will be plundered.”
verses.zh: 所以主耶和华如此说：敌人必来围攻这地，使你的势力衰微，抢掠你的家宅。

verses.en: The LORD says: “As the shepherd rescues out of the mouth of the lion two legs, or a piece of an ear, so shall the children of Israel be rescued who sit in Samaria on the corner of a couch, and on the silken cushions of a bed.”
verses.zh: 耶和华如此说：「牧人怎样从狮子口中抢回两条羊腿或半个耳朵，住撒马利亚的以色列人躺卧在床角上或铺绣花毯的榻上，他们得救也不过如此。」

words.g: from + the mouth , whether literal or figurative
the leg  of men or locusts
in + Shomeron, a place in Palestine
in + mouth in a figurative sense, i.e. direction

verses.en: “Listen, and testify against the house of Jacob,” says the Lord GOD, the God of Armies.
verses.zh: 主耶和华―万军之神说：当听这话，警戒雅各家。

words.g: the + a mass of persons , especially reg. organized forwar

verses.en: “For in the day that I visit the transgressions of Israel on him, I will also visit the altars of Bethel; and the horns of the altar will be cut off, and fall to the ground.
verses.zh: 我讨以色列罪的日子，也要讨伯特利祭坛的罪；坛角必被砍下，坠落于地。

verses.en: I will strike the winter house with the summer house; and the houses of ivory will perish, and the great houses will have an end,” says the LORD.
verses.zh: 我要拆毁过冬和过夏的房屋。象牙的房屋也必毁灭；高大的房屋都归无有。这是耶和华说的。

words.g: the + the crop gathered, i.e.  the autumn  season
the + harvest , whether the product  or the  season
and + to snatch away, i.e. terminate

verses.en: Listen to this word, you cows of Bashan, who are on the mountain of Samaria, who oppress the poor, who crush the needy, who tell their husbands, “Bring us drinks!”
verses.zh: 你们住撒马利亚山如巴珊母牛的啊，当听我的话―你们欺负贫寒的，压碎穷乏的，对家主说：拿酒来，我们喝吧！

words.g: the + Bashan , a region East of the Jordan
the + to press upon, i.e. oppress
the + to crack in pieces, literally or figuratively

verses.en: The Lord GOD has sworn by his holiness, “Behold, the days shall come on you that they will take you away with hooks, and the last of you with fish hooks.
verses.zh: 主耶和华指着自己的圣洁起誓说：日子快到，人必用钩子将你们钩去，用鱼钩将你们余剩的钩去。

words.g: and + the last or end, hence

verses.en: You will go out at the breaks in the wall, everyone straight before her; and you will cast yourselves into Harmon,” says the LORD.
verses.zh: 你们各人必从破口直往前行，投入哈门。这是耶和华说的。

verses.en: “Go to Bethel, and sin; to Gilgal, and sin more. Bring your sacrifices every morning, your tithes every three days,
verses.zh: 以色列人哪，任你们往伯特利去犯罪，到吉甲加增罪过；每日早晨献上你们的祭物，每三日奉上你们的十分之一。

words.g: and + to break away , i.e. trespass
the + Gilgal, the name of three places in Palestine
to + to break away , i.e. trespass

verses.en: offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving of that which is leavened, and proclaim free will offerings and brag about them; for this pleases you, you children of Israel,” says the Lord GOD.
verses.zh: 任你们献有酵的感谢祭，把甘心祭宣传报告给众人，因为是你们所喜爱的。这是主耶和华说的。

words.g: and + to smoke, i.e. turn into fragrance by fire

verses.en: “I also have given you cleanness of teeth in all your cities, and lack of bread in every town; yet you haven’t returned to me,” says the LORD.
verses.zh: 我使你们在一切城中牙齿干净，在你们各处粮食缺乏，你们仍不归向我。这是耶和华说的。

verses.en: “I also have withheld the rain from you, when there were yet three months to the harvest; and I caused it to rain on one city, and caused it not to rain on another city. One field was rained on, and the field where it didn’t rain withered.
verses.zh: 在收割的前三月，我使雨停止，不降在你们那里；我降雨在这城，不降雨在那城；这块地有雨，那块地无雨；无雨的就枯干了。

words.g: to debar  from benefit or injury

verses.en: So two or three cities staggered to one city to drink water, and were not satisfied; yet you haven’t returned to me,” says the LORD.
verses.zh: 这样，两三城的人凑到一城去找水，却喝不足；你们仍不归向我。这是耶和华说的。

words.g: and + to waver, in a great variety of applications

verses.en: “I struck you with blight and mildew many times in your gardens and your vineyards, and the swarming locusts have devoured your fig trees and your olive trees; yet you haven’t returned to me,” says the LORD.
verses.zh: 我以旱风、霉烂攻击你们，你们园中许多菜蔬、葡萄树、无花果树、橄榄树都被剪虫所吃；你们仍不归向我。这是耶和华说的。

words.g: and + in + paleness, whether of persons

verses.en: “I sent plagues among you like I did Egypt. I have slain your young men with the sword, and have carried away your horses. I filled your nostrils with the stench of your camp, yet you haven’t returned to me,” says the LORD.
verses.zh: 我降瘟疫在你们中间，像在埃及一样；用刀杀戮你们的少年人，使你们的马匹被掳掠，营中尸首的臭气扑鼻；你们仍不归向我。这是耶和华说的。

words.g: Mitsrajim, i.e. Upper and Lower Egypt

verses.en: “I have overthrown some of you, as when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah, and you were like a burning stick plucked out of the fire; yet you haven’t returned to me,” says the LORD.
verses.zh: 我倾覆你们中间的城邑，如同我从前倾覆所多玛、蛾摩拉一样，使你们好像从火中抽出来的一根柴；你们仍不归向我。这是耶和华说的。

words.g: Sedom, a place near the Dead Sea

verses.en: “Therefore I will do this to you, Israel; because I will do this to you, prepare to meet your God, Israel.
verses.zh: 以色列啊，我必向你如此行；以色列啊，我既这样行，你当预备迎见你的神。

words.g: a heel, i.e.  the last of anything

verses.en: For, behold, he who forms the mountains, creates the wind, declares to man what is his thought, who makes the morning darkness, and treads on the high places of the earth: The LORD, the God of Armies, is his name.”
verses.zh: 那创山、造风、将心意指示人、使晨光变为幽暗、脚踏在地之高处的，他的名是耶和华―万军之神。

words.g: a mass of persons , especially reg. organized forwar

verses.en: Listen to this word which I take up for a lamentation over you, O house of Israel:
verses.zh: 以色列家啊，要听我为你们所作的哀歌：

verses.en: “The virgin of Israel has fallen; She shall rise no more. She is cast down on her land; there is no one to raise her up.”
verses.zh: 以色列民（原文是处女）跌倒，不得再起；躺在地上，无人搀扶。

verses.en: For the Lord GOD says: “The city that went out a thousand shall have a hundred left, and that which went out one hundred shall have ten left to the house of Israel.”
verses.zh: 主耶和华如此说：以色列家的城发出一千兵的，只剩一百；发出一百的，只剩十个。

words.g: to swell up, i.e. be  redundant
to swell up, i.e. be  redundant

verses.en: For the LORD says to the house of Israel: “Seek me, and you will live;

verses.zh: 他们必飘流，从这海到那海，从北边到东边，往来奔跑，寻求耶和华的话，却寻不着。

verses.zh: 那指着撒马利亚牛犊（原文是罪）起誓的说：但哪，我们指着你那里的活神起誓；又说：我们指着别是巴的神道（神：原文是活）起誓。这些人都必仆倒，永不再起来。

verses.zh: 我看见主站在祭坛旁边；他说：你要击打柱顶，使门槛震动，打碎柱顶，落在众人头上；所剩下的人，我必用刀杀戮，无一人能逃避，无一人能逃脱。

verses.zh: 那在天上建造楼阁、在地上安定穹苍、命海水浇在地上的―耶和华是他的名。

verses.zh: 耶和华说：以色列人哪，我岂不看你们如古实人吗？我岂不是领以色列人出埃及地，领非利士人出迦斐托，领亚兰人出吉珥吗？

verses.zh: 主耶和华的眼目察看这有罪的国，必将这国从地上灭绝，却不将雅各家灭绝净尽。这是耶和华说的。

verses.zh: 我必出令，将以色列家分散在列国中，好像用筛子筛谷，连一粒也不落在地上。
